item.title: Resolving JavaFX IllegalAccessError with Java Module System
item.description:
“Resolving JavaFX IllegalAccessError with Java Module System”

How do you correct a java.lang.IllegalAccessError when loading JavaFX media components, specifically when the error points to an unnamed module attempting to access an exported class within the javafx.graphics module?

The observed error typically looks like this:

java.lang.IllegalAccessError: class com.sun.media.jfxmediaimpl.NativeMediaManager (in unnamed module @0x4d7be377) cannot access class com.sun.glass.utils.NativeLibLoader (in module javafx.graphics) because module javafx.graphics does not export com.sun.glass.utils to unnamed module @0x4d7be377

Deep Dive into the Module Problem

This error signifies that a class belonging to the unnamed module (classes loaded from the classpath) is trying to reflectively access an internal class within the named module javafx.graphics. The named module explicitly restricts this access via qualified exports or opens directives, which are only respected when the accessing code is also properly recognized as a module or part of the module system’s awareness.
